scripts.format: prettier --write . --ignore-unknown && uv --project quality_checker run ruff check --fix main.py quality_checker/src quality_checker/tests && uv --project quality_checker run ruff format main.py quality_checker/src quality_checker/tests
scripts.lint: prettier --check . --ignore-unknown && uv --project quality_checker run ruff format --check main.py quality_checker/src quality_checker/tests && uv --project quality_checker run ruff check main.py quality_checker/src quality_checker/tests
scripts.typecheck: uv --project quality_checker run ty check main.py quality_checker/src/quality_checker/application.py quality_checker/src/quality_checker/checkers quality_checker/src/quality_checker/db quality_checker/src/quality_checker/smoke.py
scripts.test: uv --project quality_checker run python -m unittest discover -s quality_checker/tests
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
